headline: Attack of the Elements! - version 1.4.0
openingRemarks: New Foes, New Elemental Traits, and a Special HeroFit Event

newFeatures.title: Elemental Foes
newFeatures.description: Corruption has overtaken the Elementals of Earth Realm, becoming powerful adversaries in the process. Each element has 3 new foes, a minion, adept, and a leviathan, each with more elemental power than the last.

newFeatures.title: Elemental Traits
newFeatures.description: Each of the 4 elements now have a unique battle trait! Fire: Critical Strike, Earth: Thorns Damage, Air: Evasion, Water: Vampiric Touch. The more you've developed your Heroes' elements, the bigger impact the elemental traits will have in battles.

newFeatures.title: Attack of the Elements! A unique HeroFit Event
newFeatures.description: Over the course of the next 12 weeks, one new Elemental Foe will be released, becoming available to battle. These foes will specialize in one of the four elements - Earth, Water, Air or Fire, challenging you in unique ways based on their elemental prowess. There will be an increased chance to engage the enemy of the week, plus bonus XP and PT!

bugFixes: Fixed a bug where heroes with more than 250 activities recorded experienced a bug with leveling up
Fixed bug where the elemental season bonus wasn't appearing in old Battle Reports
Fixed an issue with equipping items affecting other players
Refactored some code to prevent users from players losing PT in the event of an error buying consumable items
balanceChanges: Global changes to foe difficulty ahead of elemental trait addition
HeroFit needs your help to help judge and report any balance issues you see after this patch!
miscDetails: Changes to the Battle Report Detail, which now displays all damage types every round. Previously, physical and element rounds alternated
Added a fresh background image inspired by the special event
closingRemarks: I'm very excited for this patch! It's been a goal to make the elements unique since the very beginning of HeroFit and now with the new traits, it's finally become a reality. How you workout and how you spend your Quantum Points will greatly affect your battles. Not only that, I finally get to reveal the amazing artwork that's being produced by Cold Beverage Studios, giving me more time to develop the game.
